chunks: "May Allah not grant you success for Eid al-Fitr or Eid al-Adha."

key_terms.أَضْحًى: Eid al-Adha, the festival of sacrifice
key_terms.اللَّهُ: Allah, the One invoked in the supplication
key_terms.حَدِيثٍ: a hadith or narration being cited
key_terms.لِفِطْرٍ: for Eid al-Fitr, the festival marking the end of fasting
key_terms.وَفَّقَكُمُ: grant you success or divine enablement

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith mean by saying, "May Allah not grant you success for Eid al-Fitr or Eid al-Adha"?
ai.summary: This narration conveys a supplication of censure, asking that a people not be granted success in reaching or properly observing Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha. In context, it reflects disapproval connected to worship and fasting-related conduct.
